verses: Burjoon walay aasman ki qasam
Wada kiye huye din ki qasam
Hazir honey walay aur hazir kiye gaye ki qasam
)kay (kahndaqon walay halak kiye gaye
Woh aik aag thi endhan wali
Jab kay woh log uss kay aas pass bethay thay
Aur musalmanon kay sath jo ker rahey thay uss ko apney samney dekh rahey thay
Yeh log unn musalmanon (kay kissi aur gunah ka) badla nahi ley rahey thay, siwaye uss kay kay woh Allah ghalib laeeq hamd ki zaat per eman laye thay
Jiss kay liye aasman o zamin ka mulk hai. Aur Allah Taalaa kay samney hai her cheez
Be-shak jin logon ney musalman mardon aur aurton ko sataya phir tauba (bhi) na ki to unn kay liye jahannum ka azab hai aur jalney ka azab hai
Be-shak eman qabool kerney walon aur nek kaam kerney walon kay liye woh baghaat hain. Jin kay neechay nehrein beh rahi hain. Yehi bari kaamyabi hai
Yaqeenan teray rab ki pakar bari sakht hai
O hi pehli martaba peda kerta hai aur o hi doobara peda keray ga
Woh bara bakhsish kerney wala aur boht mohabbat kerney wala hai
Arsh ka malik azmat wala hai
Jo chahaye ussay ker guzarney wala hai
Tujhay lashkaron ki khabar bhi mili hai?
(yani) Firaun aur samood ki
(kuch nahi) balkay)yeh kafir to jhutlanay mein paray huye hain
Aur Allah Taalaa bhi unhen her taraf say gheray huye hai
Balkay)yeh yeh Quran hai bari shaan wala
Loh mehfooz mein (likha hua)
